🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive (64%, Internal Rotation); Leadership: Broad (4 sectors across the Top 5). Confirmation is mixed: seven sectors advanced, four declined, and major-stock divergences are widespread—transitional conditions, not a strong directional signal.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead the week: DOW (1W: +12.34% | 1M: +23.61%) and PPG (1W: +7.51% | 1M: +11.71%), both ABOVE TREND. Real Estate follows with CCI (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +30.82%), ABOVE TREND; Industrials are positive, led by LMT (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%), ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication is weakest, with TTWO (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -3.69%) and T (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -14.49%), both BELOW TREND. Energy is also negative: PSX (1W: -5.62% | 1M: +8.53%) and MPC (1W: -5.81% | 1M: +12.43%) are in CORRECTION; Financials slipped 0.17% for the week, while JPM (1W: +1.23% | 1M: +1.79%) remains ABOVE TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top five: LMT (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%), PANW (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +1.57%), DOW (1W: +12.34% | 1M: +23.61%), ORCL (1W: +11.93% | 1M: +5.29%) and CCI (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +30.82%), all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors across the Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom five: TTWO (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -3.69%), T (1W: -5.52% | 1M: -14.49%), MRK (1W: -5.97% | 1M: -5.59%), BKNG (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -8.87%) and META (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -17.10%), all BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Communication, Healthcare, Consumer Discretionary and Technology.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest one-week advances include LMT (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%), PANW (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +1.57%) and DOW (1W: +12.34% | 1M: +23.61%), all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: AAPL (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.38%), MSFT (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +4.33%) and AMZN (1W: -2.96% | 1M: +3.21%) are in CORRECTION; watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology was up 0.89% for the week and 2.25% for the month, but leadership is uneven: PANW (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +1.57%), ORCL (1W: +11.93% | 1M: +5.29%) and TXN (1W: +8.85% | 1M: +9.99%) are ABOVE TREND. AAPL (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.38%) and MSFT (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +4.33%) are in CORRECTION; NVDA (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.21%), GOOGL (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -4.70%) and META (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -17.10%) are BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials slipped 0.17% for the week but gained 2.83% over the month, a mixed backdrop. JPM (1W: +1.23% | 1M: +1.79%) is ABOVE TREND, while V (1W: -1.78% | 1M: +9.49%) and MA (1W: -1.98% | 1M: +8.46%) are in CORRECTION; stock-level sector breadth was not supplied.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare advanced 0.76% for the week and 4.76% for the month, with mixed constituent signals. JNJ (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +1.30%) and LLY (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +8.75%) are ABOVE TREND, while MRK (1W: -5.97% | 1M: -5.59%) is BELOW TREND and UNH (1W: -2.37% | 1M: +8.58%) is in CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to relative-strength names such as LMT (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%) and ORCL (1W: +11.93% | 1M: +5.29%), both ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to persistently weak META (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -17.10%), BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major divergence argues for tactical positioning, not a strong regime bet.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LMT (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%), ABOVE TREND; monitor continuation after its defense-deal catalyst. ORCL (1W: +11.93% | 1M: +5.29%), ABOVE TREND; watch whether AI-spending optimism sustains momentum.
BEARISH: META (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -17.10%) and BA (1W: -13.07% | 1M: -10.94%), both BELOW TREND; monitor for further downside or stabilization.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (+1.83% 1W; +6.51% 1M) and Industrials (+1.13% 1W; +1.67% 1M) led, with broad individual-stock leadership in Materials and strong LMT performance in Industrials. BEARISH: Communication (-2.66% 1W; -4.37% 1M) remains weakest; Energy fell 0.75% this week despite a 11.14% monthly gain.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied, so avoid treating return data as price support or resistance. Watch whether LMT (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%), ABOVE TREND, sustains its advance; monitor META (1W: -12.19% | 1M: -17.10%), BELOW TREND, for stabilization, and AAPL (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.38%), CORRECTION, for a return to positive weekly momentum.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LMT (+60): major defense deal; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%), confirming the positive catalyst. LLY (+80): earnings beat and raised guidance; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +8.75%), confirming; ORCL (+45): optimism around AI spending returns; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.93% | 1M: +5.29%), confirming. MRK (+75): Q3 beat and raised outlook, but price BELOW TREND (1W: -5.97% | 1M: -5.59%), a sentiment-price divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CAT (-55): revenue miss and weaker outlook; price BELOW TREND (1W: -3.40% | 1M: -13.50%), confirming the negative catalyst. VST (+50) is a positive-news/weak-price divergence: data-center deal headline versus CORRECTION (1W: -8.59% | 1M: +1.34%). Other bearish headlines lack matching return data here, so price confirmation cannot be assessed.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with 7/11 sectors positive and style mixed / no clear leadership; Top 5 leadership is Broad across four sectors. LMT (1W: +14.19% | 1M: +22.95%) and ORCL (1W: +11.93% | 1M: +5.29%) are showing relative strength, both ABOVE TREND. Major divergence across large-cap names calls for confirmation, while MRK’s positive news sentiment conflicts with its BELOW TREND price action.
